Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.clients

Class RegisteredClientMapper

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.clients.RegisteredClientMapper
@Component public class RegisteredClientMapper extends Object
Maps the domain ClientRegistration onto Spring Authorization Server's RegisteredClient and back. The audiences, which the framework has no field for, travel as the "settings.client.audiences" custom client setting.

    • MFA_REQUIRED_SETTING

      public static final String MFA_REQUIRED_SETTING
      Name of the custom client setting that makes every user of the client complete a second factor. It is only written and read here: everybody else asks ClientRegistration.mfaRequired() through the client port.

    • toRegisteredClient

      public org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.authorization.client.RegisteredClient toRegisteredClient(ClientRegistration registration, String id, Instant issuedAt, String secret)
      Maps a registration to a registered client.
      Parameters:
      registration - the registration.
      id - internal identifier of the registered client.
      issuedAt - instant the client identifier was issued.
      secret - encoded secret, or null.
      Returns:
      the registered client.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the token endpoint signing algorithm is not a JWS signature algorithm.

    • toRegistration

      public ClientRegistration toRegistration(org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.authorization.client.RegisteredClient client)
      Maps a registered client to a registration. The framework keeps these collections as sets, so they are returned sorted to make the result deterministic. A client is confidential unless it authenticates with none.
      Parameters:
      client - the registered client.
      Returns:
      the registration.
